name: Cephalid Illusionist
oracle_text:
Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, mill three cards.
{2}{U}, {T}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by target creature you control this turn.
blocked_sentences: {2}{U}, {T}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by target creature you control this turn.

needs.what: a `combat_only: true` option on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (a field on structs.PermanentShield read by primitives.damage_permanent / damage_player), so a resolving ability can install a this-turn shield that stops only COMBAT damage dealt to and dealt by one targeted permanent
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` with dealt: to_and_by and duration: this_turn is the right shape but stops ALL damage, so noncombat burn at the creature and its own ping/fight damage would also be prevented (a strictly better card); `combat_only` exists only on the `prevent_damage` static, which is continuous on a printed permanent and cannot be installed on a target for a turn by an activated ability
